_comment: PR1 / INV-002 (RS-005) — the CLOSED role/kind -> projection-policy identity map. comparison_status=equal may be minted ONLY when every RECORDED per-role projection-policy identity (schema id/version + digest + canonicalization version) is set-equal to the pinned policy here. A degenerate/no-op projection that records an OFF-MANIFEST policy identity is rejected with reason projection-policy-mismatch (INV-012) — so `equal` cannot be minted from hashes produced by a projection other than the manifest-pinned one. The projection_schema_digest is the committed evidence-schema digest (SpecConstants.EvidenceSchemaSha256); all five roles share the single reviewed projection policy. Committed artifact, never an in-test literal (RS-020).
_impl_pin_comment: RS-005 hardening (QA-005): projection_impl_digest is the SHA-256 of the REAL EvidenceSchema.DeterministicProjection output over the committed projection_self_test_vector. The producer computes this over the same vector and records it in every RoleEvidence cell; DeterminismComparison cross-checks recorded==pinned, so a producer running a DIFFERENT projection (a degenerate/no-op that merely stamps the pinned schema-identity string) yields a different impl-digest on the vector and is rejected (projection-policy-mismatch) on a REAL receipt. Committed value, never an in-test literal (RS-020). Recompute via `dotnet exec SpikeAggregator.dll --print-projection-impl-digest --schema schema/evidence-schema.json --vector <projection_self_test_vector>` if the projection code or the vector changes (a reviewable committed diff).
